name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2025-11-02, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
